Width, camber, local material changes and jumps are approximate. Reviewed genuine sharp junctions: OSM 69465111/30406194 at the southern 171/17019 turn, and 218840136/436846217 at 17224/17220, both visible in the published map; source node topology retained.

stageName: Świętajno — Pietrasze to Chełchy — Road Recreation
method: Southern part of the published 2024 Świętajno spectator map: Pietrasze, Jelonek, Zalesie and Chełchy. Ends before the northern Gryzy/Mazury competition loop. Current drivable roads, not an exact historical timing-control reconstruction. Current OSM road geometry, game timing boundaries and DEM terrain; not a surveyed official stage. Width, camber, local material changes and jumps are approximate. The mapped southern approach uses a short 655 section before joining the gravel corridor; this differs from the competition forest approach. Jelonek waypoint is on the through-road junction, not the village spur. Sharp current-road junction 749553159/178760572 is topologically connected; the alternate southern approach makes this turn sharper than the published competition approach.
